title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20
source: This is a pitch corrected, patched and re-mastered version of the shnid1234 sbd.hollister source

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance with a solid period‑song mix, though Bob and Donna Jean's vocals on Sunshine Daydream sound strained
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the show as an excellent cross‑section of the late‑1973 era, especially when paired with Road Trips Vol. 4, but notes that the vocal delivery on Sunshine Daydream is ragged. Overall the performance is deemed solid despite the vocal hiccup.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review emphasizes strong show quality with only minor vocal issues, leading to a high rating but limited data for confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on sound clarity or mix; assumed acceptable given overall positive impression.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer views the set as a solid representation of the period, indicating good pacing and song selection.

band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal chords sound shredded on Sunshine Daydream.
